name: NewMathDiscovery.RankedCoalescence.covered_ranked_coalescence_sound
type:
∀ {α C W : Type} (f : α → α) (one : α) (decode : C → α) (rank : C → W) (lt : W → W → Prop)
  (edge : C → Nat → Nat → C → Prop) (Entry : C → Prop) (Domain : α → Prop),
  f one = one →
    (WellFounded fun c' c => lt (rank c') (rank c)) →
      (∀ (c : C), decode c ≠ one → ∃ a b c', edge c a b c') →
        (∀ {c : C} {a b : Nat} {c' : C},
            edge c a b c' →
              NewMathDiscovery.RankedCoalescence.iterate f a (decode c) =
                NewMathDiscovery.RankedCoalescence.iterate f b (decode c')) →
          (∀ {c : C} {a b : Nat} {c' : C}, edge c a b c' → lt (rank c') (rank c)) →
            (∀ (x : α), Domain x → ∃ c, Entry c ∧ decode c = x) →
              ∀ (x : α), Domain x → NewMathDiscovery.RankedCoalescence.Reaches f one x

name: NewMathDiscovery.LinearBlindness.System.mk
type:
{Index State Value : Type} →
  (zeroState : State) →
    (subState : State → State → State) →
      (zeroValue : Value) →
        (subValue : Value → Value → Value) →
          (observe : Index → State → Value) →
            (target : State → Value) →
              (∀ (i : Index), observe i zeroState = zeroValue) →
                target zeroState = zeroValue →
                  (∀ (i : Index) (x y : State), observe i (subState x y) = subValue (observe i x) (observe i y)) →
                    (∀ (x y : State), target (subState x y) = subValue (target x) (target y)) →
                      (∀ (a b : Value), subValue a b = zeroValue ↔ a = b) →
                        NewMathDiscovery.LinearBlindness.System Index State Value

type:

  {motive : NewMathDiscovery.LinearBlindness.System Index State Value → Sort u} →

      ((zeroState : State) →
          (subState : State → State → State) →
            (zeroValue : Value) →
              (subValue : Value → Value → Value) →
                (observe : Index → State → Value) →
                  (target : State → Value) →
                    (observe_zero : ∀ (i : Index), observe i zeroState = zeroValue) →
                      (target_zero : target zeroState = zeroValue) →
                        (observe_sub :
                            ∀ (i : Index) (x y : State),
                              observe i (subState x y) = subValue (observe i x) (observe i y)) →
                          (target_sub : ∀ (x y : State), target (subState x y) = subValue (target x) (target y)) →
                            (sub_eq_zero_iff : ∀ (a b : Value), subValue a b = zeroValue ↔ a = b) →
                              motive
                                { zeroState := zeroState, subState := subState, zeroValue := zeroValue,
                                  subValue := subValue, observe := observe, target := target,
                                  observe_zero := observe_zero, target_zero := target_zero, observe_sub := observe_sub,
                                  target_sub := target_sub, sub_eq_zero_iff := sub_eq_zero_iff }) →
        motive t
